title: Ex-Freemason claims 1946 occult ritual opened ‘portal’ to UFO sightings
description: Sean Stone, son of Hollywood director Oliver Stone, contends that aliens are demons coming through portals opened by occultist Aliester Crowley, Scientology founder L. Ron Hubbard, and scientist Jack Parsons.

title: Harvard UFO Hunter From Boston Lands White House Council Gig
description: Harvard's Avi Loeb will chair a new UAP Science Advisory Council advising the White House; the group has requested more than 50 Pentagon records.

title: Indian researcher Devesh Nandal named to Harvard-led UAP Science Advisory Council
description: Indian astrophysicist Dr. Devesh Nandal has been appointed to Harvard's UAP Science Advisory Council, tasked with analyzing unexplained aerial phenomena.
